subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Cities That Banned Facial Recognition
description: A quick win: understand Cities That Banned Facial Recognition.

hook.text: San Francisco, the heart of Silicon Valley, became the first major city to ban government facial recognition.

buildup.text: The 2019 ban prohibited police and city agencies from using the technology entirely.

discovery.text: Boston, Portland, and several other cities followed with their own bans on facial recognition.

twist.text: The bans only cover government use. Private companies can still use facial recognition freely.

climax.text: City bans prove that communities can push back. But without federal law, the patchwork has gaps.

punchline.text: Banned by cities. Still used by companies.

quiz.question: What was the first major U.S. city to ban government facial recognition?
